understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by stepping onto each goal cell while the carried piece simultaneously matched the goal's required shape, color, and rotation. Completing all goals in a level advanced to the next level, and winning all levels completed the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move cost one stamina point, and reaching zero stamina cost a life before resetting stamina to its maximum. Walls blocked movement, so blocked_directions had to be checked before every move. Shape modifiers cycled shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycled colors orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotated the piece clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal activated only when all three piece attributes matched its requirements, and stepping onto an activated goal completed it.
